# Location scope. Zone 1: Anxi (Western Regions & Central Asia).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_1 = {
	OR = {
		region = region:xinjiang_region
		region = region:khorasan_region
		region = region:tibet_region
	}
}

# Location scope. Zone 2: Beiting (Steppe & Siberia).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_2 = {
	OR = {
		sub_continent = sub_continent:north_asia
		region = region:mongolia_region
		region = region:ural_region
		region = region:steppes_region
	}
}

# Location scope. Zone 3: Nurgan (Manchuria & Amur Frontier).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_3 = {
	region = region:manchuria_region
}

# Location scope. Zone 4: Annam (Mainland Indochina).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_4 = {
	region = region:indochina_region
	NOT = { area = area:malay_peninsula_area }
}

# Location scope. Zone 5: Nanyang-Palembang (Malaya & Indonesia).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_5 = {
	OR = {
		region = region:indonesia_region
		area = area:malay_peninsula_area
	}
}

# Location scope. Zone 6: Xiyang-Ceylon (Indian Ocean & South Asia).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_6 = {
	sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
}

# Location scope. Zone 7: Anxi-Persia (Persia & Middle East).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_7 = {
	sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east
}

# Location scope. Zone 8: Taixi-Daqin (Mediterranean & Europe).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_8 = {
	continent = continent:europe
	NOT = { region = region:steppes_region }
	NOT = { region = region:ural_region }
}

# Location scope. Zone 9: Fusang-Dongying (Japanese Archipelago).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_9 = {
	region = region:japan_region
}

# Location scope. Zone 10: Xinzhou (Pacific Americas).
oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_10 = {
	OR = {
		sub_continent = sub_continent:north_america
		sub_continent = sub_continent:south_america
	}
}

# Country scope (emperor). Has an active Zone 1 Grand Protectorate.
oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_1 = {
	any_subject = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
		var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 1
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Subject-Scope Helper for oe_cel3_ci_grant_zone_lands
# ==============================================================================

# Subject scope (recipient). True when scope:actor owns at least one non-capital location in this subject's zone.
oe_cel3_actor_has_zone_lands_for_subject = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 1
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_1 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 2
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_2 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 3
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_3 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 4
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_4 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 5
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_5 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 6
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_6 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 7
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_7 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 8
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_8 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 9
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_9 = yes
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 10
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_10 = yes
				}
			}
		}

# Country scope (emperor). Has at least one Grand Protectorate or Pacification Commission.
oe_cel3_has_tribute_subject = {
	any_subject = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Continent Bucket 1: Asian Frontier & Maritime (Zones 1,3,4,5,6,7,9 or non-heartland Asia).
oe_cel3_has_continent_asia_frontier = {
	OR = {
		oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_1 = yes
		oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_3 = yes
		oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_4 = yes
		oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_5 = yes
		oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_6 = yes
		oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_7 = yes
		oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_9 = yes
		any_subject = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
			}
			capital ?= {
				continent = continent:asia
				NOT = { oe_cel_is_chinese_heartland = yes }
				NOT = { oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_2 = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (emperor). Holds Pacific Grand Protectorate (Fusang or Xinzhou).

# Country scope (western partner). Directly or via subject holds an Egypt / Red Sea / Indian Ocean anchor.
oe_cel3_controls_red_sea_or_io_anchor = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:alexandria
		owns = location:cairo
		owns = location:suez
		owns = location:jeddah
		owns = location:suakin
		owns = location:massawa
		owns = location:hormuz
		owns = location:goa
		owns = location:kozhikode
		owns = location:kotte
		any_subject = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				owns = location:alexandria
				owns = location:cairo
				owns = location:suez
				owns = location:jeddah
				owns = location:suakin
				owns = location:massawa
				owns = location:hormuz
				owns = location:goa
				owns = location:kozhikode
				owns = location:kotte
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (western partner). BYZ, ROM, or Nostos-active Nova Elysia controlling a Red Sea / Indian Ocean anchor.
oe_cel3_is_roman_io_partner = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
		AND = {
			oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
			has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
		}
	}
	oe_cel3_controls_red_sea_or_io_anchor = yes
}

# Country scope (western partner). Roman or Nova Elysia power holding >= 3 distant subjects.
oe_cel3_is_concert_western_partner = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	exists = capital
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
		oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
	}
	any_subject = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		capital ?= {
			NOT = { region = prev.capital.region }
		}
		count >= 3
	}
}
